Gentofte is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report benchmarks clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Register (DanStroke) to drive local quality development in the healthcare system [^src1]. 

Specifically, Gentofte is included in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. The municipality's data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is detailed on page 93 of the report, providing specific numerators, denominators, and confidence intervals for this cross-sectional quality assessment [^src1]. Because the available evidence is limited to this single tabular mention, no further historical timeline, distinct claims, or direct entity relationships are documented for Gentofte in this corpus.
